existingVideos.title: OnCollision Enter·Stay·Exit·AABB | 충돌 이벤트 구현
content: 00:02–11:41: collision pair IDs, union/map state and collider sizes
11:45–17:11:2D AABB overlap using centers and summed half extents on X/Y, including touching and debugger verification
17:14–26:39: Enter/Stay/Exit state transitions, script callbacks and object response
existingVideos.geometryOverlap: Actual overlap found:2D center/half-extent AABB intersection is already explained. Briefly acknowledge it as a prerequisite; make3D componentwise bounds construction, affine transformation, transformed-box enclosure and false-positive limits the new main claims. Do not recreate the collision callback implementation.

candidateDifferences.newQuestionAndClaims: Compare implicit/parametric/direct forms, distinguish ray/line/segment parameter domains, test a sphere versus its solid interior, construct componentwise AABBs and compare transformed-point bounds with transformed-box bounds.
candidateDifferences.reuseLimit: Briefly recall displacement/normalization and the existing2D AABB overlap lecture; focus on geometric representations,3D bounds construction/transforms and proxy limitations. Additional actual collision-video comparison remains required.

candidateDifferences.newQuestionAndClaims: Compute affine plane equations, scale normal and offset consistently, calculate signed distance/projection, reconstruct barycentric weights and reject off-plane queries.
candidateDifferences.reuseLimit: Cross-product/winding reminders support a plane-normal calculation; do not repeat the old lighting/view-cone material.

candidateDifferences.newQuestionAndClaims: Separate triangle centroid/incenter/circumcenter, validate contours, compare convex and concave fan behavior and explain a separately audited ear-removal example.
candidateDifferences.reuseLimit: A short orientation reminder supports signed area; center and partition calculations provide the new lesson.
